about: Known problems shown on problems.html / tr/sorunlar.html. One case per problem: our number CP-<year>-<n> (never reused), the day it was first stated, its state (looking, accepted, fixed, not-defect), the release that fixed it, a one-sentence summary in our own words in both languages, what to do meanwhile or why it is not a defect, and the release-notes or lab lines that prove it, each as {"cite": path:line, "says": a phrase of that line} (the phrase rule of site/sources.go). Never a reporter's name, server, domain or own words. A security problem is added only after the release that closes it is published. site.TestProblemsAndChangelog checks every field.
